events.evidence: At least 100 people are killed in an airstrike by the military junta in the village of Pazigyi
Fighting occurs near the Armenian village of Tegh, resulting in the deaths of four Armenian and three Azerbaijani soldiers
The World Health Organization reports the first death from H3N8 in a 56-year-old woman in Guangdong Province, China

label.note: Myanmar massacre and Armenia-Azerbaijan clashes dominate; H3N8 death adds health concern.
